description: A Boeing 747-121 standing at Deokso Church and mapped in 2019; the OSM description names it as Pan Am 'Clipper Juan T. Trippe' but no registration is given and the Pan Am identity is almost certainly applied livery rather than provenance; the object is tagged both amenity=place_of_worship and historic=aircraft which indicates the airframe is in church use; this is the "aircraft converted to another use and publicly visitable" case; needs a photograph to confirm the airframe is real rather than a mock-up
aliases: 747-100; 747100; B747; Jumbo Jet; Clipper Juan T. Trippe
